verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a tax-compliance SaaS that stores transaction and customer data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents retention settings, data deletion, or purge capabilities. Cancelling certificate requests and reversing refunds are lifecycle operations on tax records, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
